cells.gaps: The strategy is known only from the minister's presentation of its main orientations on 3 April 2026 (GAB-063), which states no adoption or text; no period, delivery plan, reporting, body or finance row has been found for it, and its sector master plans are still to be drawn up. The predecessor, Plan national stratégique Gabon Digital 2025, ended in 2025 (GAB-002); its body and finance rows (GAB-003 to GAB-005) are not carried to the new instrument.
cells.note: Instrument: the stratégie nationale de digitalisation presented by the digital economy minister on 3 April 2026, a successor in preparation to the plan that ended in 2025. A minister's presentation alone is announced, which is stage 2; stage 3 needs an adoption and a public text.
